information:
**Registration info**
* Registration opens on Monday, 15th January, 12:00am (GMT+8).
* The steps for registration are as follows:
1. [Register ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/JohorCubeOpen2018/register)
2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-johor-cube-open-2018) according the events you registered.
3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration.

**In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will be recognise as 'Incomplete registration'
